headline: review_ramayana-part-1
caption:
Ramayana: Part 1, the critics' verdict: 7.1/10. Critics agree that Yash's Ravana and the visuals are the reasons to go; nine critics say the spectacle outweighs the emotion. They split on Ranbir's Rama. Rediff's Sukanya Verma, in an unrated review: "all scale, no soul".

Where: in theatres since 5 Nov.
Watch it if: You want big-screen spectacle and Yash's Ravana (10 reviews single him out).
Skip it if: You want the epic's emotion: 9 critics say the spectacle outweighs it.

Highs: Yash's Ravana is the standout · The visuals and sheer scale impress · The Zimmer-Rahman background score works
Lows: Spectacle outweighs emotion and character · Uneven pacing and choppy editing · The songs don't stand out

Score: 7.1/10, the average of 21 published critic ratings converted to /10 (mean 7.0952, rounded half-up to one decimal). Highest: Times of India 9.0/10 (thereviewmonk's conversion); DNA India 9.0/10 (thereviewmonk's conversion); Koimoi 9.0/10 (thereviewmonk's conversion). Lowest: Rediff's Sreeju Sudhakaran 5.0/10 (thereviewmonk's conversion); Outlook 2.5/5. Only reviews published on or after the 5 Nov release count. idly has not watched the film; this post consolidates published reviews.

Seen it already: did Ranbir's Rama work for you?

Sources: Reviews consolidated from Times of India, DNA India, Koimoi, DT Next, ABP Live, Filmfare, Hindustan Times, India TV, Pinkvilla, The National, Tribune India, Indian Express, NDTV, Firstpost, New Indian Express, News18, The Quint, Gulte, Great Andhra, Rediff and Outlook; unrated reviews from Mint, Rediff (Sukanya Verma), The Telegraph (t2), The Hindu (Anuj Kumar), The Hindu (Vivek M.V.), WION, The Hollywood Reporter India and The Wire. Ratings read on the outlets' pages and in the thereviewmonk and Rotten Tomatoes critics lists.
